title: God Speaks vs Anxiety: Know the Difference
hook: God speaks. So does anxiety. Learn the difference.
script: God speaks. So does anxiety. Learn the difference. God's voice is anchored in Scripture. He will never say what His Word forbids. He also guides by the Spirit's promptings that look like Jesus and bear the fruit of peace, purity, and gentleness. And He leads through providence: doors that open or close in His timing. Counterfeits sound loud and rushed, like a ticking clock. They flatter the ego or pile on shame. And they twist or ignore the Bible. Simple filter: truth over thrill, peace over panic, humility over hype. Breathe. Pray: Lord, tune my heart to Your Word, Your Spirit, and Your way.

title: 6-Question Test to Discern God's Voice
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: If God feels silent right now, watch this. Here's a 60-second test to discern a nudge. One: Does it agree with Scripture, not just a vibe? Two: Does it make me look more like Jesus in love, patience, and truth? Three: Does it produce peace and clarity, not frantic fear? Four: Do mature believers confirm it when I invite input? Five: Is it free from flattery and crushing shame? Six: Can I obey without manipulating outcomes? If any answer is no, pause. God's guidance stands up to time and testing. Pray with me: Speak, Lord. I'm listening, and I'm willing to wait.

title: 3 Ways God Leads Today (And 3 Traps)
hook: You may be overthinking this: God's voice is simpler than you think.
script: You may be overthinking this: God's voice is simpler than you think. Three ways He leads. Word: open Scripture; His will is clear where His Word is clear. Whisper: the Spirit nudges in line with that Word, producing courage and peace. Way: providence: opportunities and roadblocks that steer your steps. Three traps to avoid: fear-fueled urgency, ego-boosting messages, and anything that bends the Bible. Quick picture: Should you apologize? God's voice brings humble courage and a chance to make it right. Counterfeits bring dread, rush, or pride. Walk slow, obey small, and watch Him confirm. Lord, guide me today.
